import json, os, subprocess, time, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

target=Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")
req_id="sonary-daw-typecheck-stage-isolation-20261008-143"
key=hashlib.sha256(str(target.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
control=root/"control"
state=root/"state"

req=control/"automation/do_again/requests"/f"{req_id}.json"
receipt=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"/f"{req_id}.json"

def read_json(p):
    try:
        v=json.loads(p.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

ps=subprocess.run(["ps","-axo","pid=,ppid=,etime=,command="],text=True,capture_output=True)
matching=[]
for line in ps.stdout.splitlines():
    if req_id in line or str(root) in line:
        matching.append(line.strip())

out={
  "request_id":req_id,
  "request_exists":req.is_file(),
  "request_mtime":req.stat().st_mtime if req.is_file() else None,
  "request_age_seconds":time.time()-req.stat().st_mtime if req.is_file() else None,
  "request":read_json(req) if req.is_file() else None,
  "receipt_exists":receipt.is_file(),
  "receipt":read_json(receipt) if receipt.is_file() else None,
  "liveness":read_json(state/"liveness.json"),
  "browser_status":read_json(state/"browser_status.json"),
  "matching_processes":matching,
}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SONARY_PENDING_REQUEST_ACTIVITY_DIAGNOSTIC_OK")
